Bethel Christian School is a coeducational school, offering education Kindergarten through to Year Twelve. The school is committed to providing comprehensive academic, physical and spiritual education. Established in 1979 the school continues to strive for excellence in providing a Christian community dedicated to serving the Mount Druitt area and beyond. The school is proud of its multicultural student population as they celebrate the diversity amongst its community members. The school was established to provide students with a Christian education, designed to serve them for the whole of life. Bethel Christian School fosters a family atmosphere and strives to promote a Christcentred culture within the community through having committed Christian teachers and staff modeling Christ to the students, parents and beyond. All subjects are taught from a Biblical Christian perspective and include weekly Chapel services and daily devotions. The school is registered with the Board of Studies NSW  and is a member of the Association of Independent Schools NSW. It is registered and accredited to provide NSW Higher School Certificate courses to students and to provide private overseas courses through CRICOS.
PACIFIC GROUP OF CHRISTIAN SCHOOLS LIMITED

The purpose of Pacific Hills Christian School is to provide a Christian educational community as a centre of teaching and learning excellence founded on biblically based beliefs, values and behaviour. To achieve that purpose the school continues to monitor a strategic mapping plan that allows the beliefs and values to be embedded in the school programs that are published for the school community and others. The School strives to attain and retain excellent Christian staff and volunteers who are committed to the vision and purpose of the School. The directors consider that attracting and retaining excellent staff and volunteers is essential for the School to continue providing quality Christian education and critical in achieving all shortterm and longterm objectives. Our strong financial management allows the school to provide the most affordable, accessible Christian education possible to the marketplace. Outcomes  enrolments for each of the schools in the Group have been increasing year on year. Academic results for students are routinely analysed and assessed to ensure the School is supporting student outcomes. Character transformation and a wholistic education is of critical concern and the Board of Directors are pleased with the performance during the year.

Purposes and Activities The Religious Charitable entity engaged in activities in Australia for the public charitable purposes of advancing the religion of Adidam Ruchiradam by, without limitation:(a)making the religion of Adidam Ruchiradam known and available to as many persons as possible, and serving and furthering their understanding and practice of that religion;(b)preserving, developing and endowing the religion of Adidam Ruchiradam and all of its sacred expressions, including its teachings, its meditation retreat sanctuaries, and its renunciate orders of practice; and(c)otherwise serving the advancement of the religion of Adidam Ruchiradam in accordance with the teachings and codes of that religion.The Religious activities of Adidam Ruchiradam include; distribution of religious literature, preparation, printing and distribution of religious newsletter, religious events, religious educational events, missionary events, religious retreats, and responding to public enquiries.
